label: Beginning in B1: first moment or finite duration of prior time, or a schematic placeholder
resolution: B1's 'contingent concrete reality begins' is read in three senses. BEGINS_1 and BEGINS_2 constrain the time before the populated moments of a history, not contingent reality itself. BEGINS_1: the time before every populated moment has a first moment (an order notion). BEGINS_2: the time before every populated moment is of finite duration on the supplied clock, CLOCK_1 intended (a metric notion; an open-below, finite past as in standard FLRW cosmology satisfies it and not BEGINS_1; with a bounded clock it reduces to population). Neither tracks the beginning of contingent reality: integer time empty before 0 and populated from 0 on has contingent reality beginning a finite time ago and satisfies neither; non-negative real time empty at 0 and populated after it satisfies BEGINS_1 with no first populated moment. A fourth sense, a first populated moment after emptiness (related to premise A3 of Arrival A, contingent things absent at a moment and present later), is named but not formalized here. BEGINS_3 is a schematic placeholder that fixes no sense: the uninterpreted Scenario predicate beginsContingency of PossibleCauseOfContingency, which the existing Arrival B premises B1 (STMT-SCENARIO-POSSIBLY-BEGINS) and B2 (STMT-SCENARIO-CAUSAL-OPPORTUNITY) use; the Scenario has no times, so the arrival is valid for every predicate. The metric Grim Reaper conclusion bears on BEGINS_2 only; it gives no first moment (MetricGrimReaper control 2). MetricBeginningArrival supplies BEGINS_2 for the placeholder and states B1 and B2 in that sense as separate statements; supplying a sense for the placeholder is instantiation, not a passage between senses. The only passage between senses is the checked strength order BEGINS_1 to BEGINS_2 in linear time (possiblyFiniteDurationOfFirstMoment), whose converse fails (MetricBeginningArrival control 2). Neither BEGINS_1 nor BEGINS_2 is the coming-to-be of one individual (TemporalHistory.BeginsAt).
